item.text: The standard Filter Tabular wrapper exposes a repeat parameter that this execution interface cannot bind reliably, so I switched to Galaxy’s ordinary text-search tool for the equivalent exact row filter (`Complete` status) and will keep the remaining column selection and intersections in Galaxy. This is still a Galaxy computation, with no local row parsing.

The first complete/single-copy ID list was produced in Galaxy by matching the BUSCO table’s status field and selecting column 1. The three remaining status filters are running; after they finish I’ll select their BUSCO-ID columns and use Galaxy inner joins for the four-way intersection.
